name: nextcloud
title: Nextcloud
concern: The user's Nextcloud account: calendar events and scheduling, to-do tasks, files, contacts, and notes.

categories.nextcloud: Nextcloud productivity: the user's calendar events and scheduling (reading or changing events and reminders) and the user's to-do tasks and task lists.

enabled.doc: Load this pack's skills and run its bridge.

token.doc: Shared secret required in the X-Semif-Token header when set.

app_password.doc: Nextcloud app password (Settings > Security > Devices & sessions), not the account password.

default_calendar.doc: Calendar used when a request names none and the account has several.

default_task_calendar.doc: VTODO-capable task list used when a request names none.

default_addressbook.doc: Addressbook used when a request names none.
